title: Dailymotion
description: Dailymotion is a video sharing platform whose palette includes red (#f64a37), purples (#7e5eff, #bb83ff), orange (#ff834c), greens (#19b5a6, #adea71), blues (#539aff, #7ae5e7), and yellow (#f2da49). Colors are documented on Dailymotion's official brand identity page.
